Hi Olivia — quick technical responses below and linking to the public docs where we keep these details. Happy to jump on a short call with your security engineers to walk through specifics.

1) SOC 2 status:
- We are SOC 2 Type II in 2025; we have an executive summary and a portability package we can share under NDA. See link: https://redwood.ai/soc2-summary (summary and scope included).

2) GDPR / HIPAA:
- We offer a DPA that covers standard GDPR terms; for HIPAA we provide a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) for customers that require it. Both are executed as addenda to our standard contract.

3) Telemetry and cookie tracking (Console vs Docs):
- Console (authenticated product):
  - Collected: event-based usage metrics (API call counts, feature usage), service-level telemetry (latency, error rates), and application logs that record operation metadata.
  - PII handling: user identifiers are hashed before being stored in telemetry systems. IP addresses are truncated/anonymized for analytics and are not stored in raw form in long-term logs unless required for a support incident.
  - Retention & access: telemetry retention defaults to 90 days for granular logs, aggregated metrics retained longer. Access is limited to SRE and security roles; we can provide a list of roles.
- Public docs site (docs.redwood.ai):
  - Uses Google Analytics (GA4) with IP anonymization enabled and cookie lifetime limited. No authenticated user data is sent to GA from the docs site.
  - We also use a small consent banner for EU visitors; cookie opt-out is respected via standard consent mechanism.

Attached: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (redacted executive summary). For the questionnaire, we’ll fill each row and flag items that need legal review. Marissa will coordinate delivery.

Links: https://docs.redwood.ai/privacy#telemetry, https://docs.redwood.ai/security/soc2

Regards,
